text: Accepted clearAll leaves a marked start page open unless alwaysClearWebBrowser is set. displayMessage and displayMessages clear the web/other message view when showing content, dispatch count updates and return when collapsed. Preserve those transition rules when extracting display helpers; indiscriminate clearAll calls can change start-page behavior, while collapsed display does not fill a hidden browser. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: MessagePane display methods clear competing views while preserving explicit start-page state
